title: nolana mollis
intro: Nolana mollis, commonly known as Chilean shrub verbena, is a flowering plant species native to the Atacama Desert in Chile. The health benefits of Nolana mollis include its potential to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments, such as digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its expectorant and spasmolytic properties. The bioactive constituents of Nolana mollis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
